name: NguonC - Phim HD
description: Stream Vietnamese movies and TV shows from phim.nguonc.com with multiple server options (Vietsub, Thuyết Minh, Lồng Tiếng).
overview: A Jellyfin channel plugin that integrates with the phim.nguonc.com API to browse and stream Vietnamese movies and TV shows.
